dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a slight concave curvature with a smooth spline transition from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius resulting in a sharp point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-degree incline relative to the horizontal longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex arc with a consistent radius of curvature along the dorsal-anterior boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, high-thickness beak with a low length-to-width ratio extending from the melon base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse interior angle measured at the pixel junction where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible polygonal geometric artifacts on the fin perimeters and a distinct circular pixel cluster on the dorsal cranial region.
